outlines.label: Restaurant main roof envelope
outlines.notes: Composite roof edge excluding NW narrow canopy and white terrace. Dark NW and terracotta SE slopes with multiple dormers. outlines.label: Restaurant northwest narrow roof or canopy
outlines.notes: Narrow dark strip beside restaurant NW side; roofing/canopy interpretation requires ground photo. Separate from main envelope to preserve the visible joint.

outlines.label: Reception and club office wing
outlines.notes: Detached southwest wing; terracotta gabled roof. Club site map A identifies reception/kansli. Roof edge uncertainty approximately 0.5 m, not wall survey.

outlines.label: Changing rooms and lodging annex wing
outlines.notes: Detached southeast wing; roof envelope includes small east projection. Club map I identifies changing rooms; club 2024 newsletter says rooms share annex with changing rooms. Roof dormers visible; exact wall and projection layout needs photo confirmation.

outlines.label: Annex northwest small roof extension
outlines.notes: Small roof at northwest end of annex; physical connection and function unresolved.

outlines.label: Courtyard southwest canopy
outlines.notes: Small courtyard roof; keep as open canopy only if photos corroborate. No walls inferred.

outlines.label: Courtyard northeast canopy
outlines.notes: Small courtyard roof. Structure and fascia visible from above; wall enclosure not established.

outlines.label: Golf cart shelter
outlines.notes: Long narrow red roof north of restaurant; site map H identifies golf carts. April 2025 shape; do not infer closed long sides.

outlines.label: Kiosk and toilets building
outlines.notes: Dark roof north of cart shelter. Club site map G identifies kiosk/toilets; adjacent terrace is separate. Tree and roof shadow obscure southwest corner; estimated edge-picking uncertainty 0.7 m.

outlines.label: South courtyard small outbuilding
outlines.notes: Small detached pitched roof south of the courtyard. Function and number of doors unresolved.

outlines.label: East courtyard long outbuilding
outlines.notes: Dark elongated roof east of south courtyard. Light wall or equipment row on southwest side; function unconfirmed.

outlines.label: Small roof beside putting green east path
outlines.notes: Tiny red roof next to east practice path; not assigned toilet/utility function without evidence.

outlines.label: Driving range covered shelter, April 2025
outlines.notes: Long rectangular roof south of putting green at east end of range mat strip. April 2025 roof predates studio and covered range plans announced December 2025; current built condition unverified.

outlines.label: Northern service-area large roof
outlines.notes: Large bright southeast roof slope and dark northwest slope. Yard/equipment visible; maintenance use is plausible but not established by orthophoto. Minor roof perspective/orthorectification displacement expected; not wall footprint.

outlines.label: Northern neighbouring building, west of road-side group
outlines.notes: Independent nearby roof; inclusion gives course-side context, not evidence of golf-club ownership.

outlines.label: Northern neighbouring building, north
outlines.notes: Dark rectangular roof, visible chimney. Ownership and function unconfirmed.

outlines.label: Northern neighbouring building, east
outlines.notes: Roof projected outline; raised-roof perspective means silhouette differs from base.

outlines.label: Northern neighbouring building, south
outlines.notes: Detached dark roof; no golf-club use established.

outlines.label: North parking and motorhome hardstanding
outlines.notes: Visible contiguous hardstanding; plot numbers and present occupancy must come from site map. April 2025 photo visibly has fewer occupied pads; edge under parked cars uncertain by 1–2 m.

outlines.label: South parking hardstanding
outlines.notes: Asphalt/gravel parking surface outline, excluding road; internal painted bays and obstructions require separate observation.

outlines.label: Putting green south of courtyard
outlines.notes: Visible maintained turf extent in April 2025. Not an official play boundary; shadows and seasonal colour give edge-picking uncertainty of several pixels.

outlines.label: Driving range mat strip, April 2025
outlines.notes: Continuous range hitting strip. Individual rectangular pads are visible; topology and covered studio plan may have changed after December 2025.

outlines.label: Kiosk southwest terrace
outlines.notes: Narrow platform immediately southwest of kiosk roof, partly tree-shadow obscured. Needs ground photograph before modelling supports/railings.

outlines.label: Restaurant northwest terrace
outlines.notes: Bright platform around southwest/northwest end of main building, excluding canopy. Extent partially hidden by roof; approximate image boundary, not measured deck elevation.

readme:
ANGSO / FACILITY MODELLING REFERENCES / 2026-09-10
Metre units. X east, Y grid north, Z up. EPSG:3006 origin E605530 N6605140.
Z for the laser is RH2000 minus the recorded height origin; map planes use a
separate arbitrary flat display datum. Do not infer terrain heights from the map.
Disable the image planes before inspecting the 3D laser/roof supports, which
may fall below the flat image datum. The height origin is stored on the scene.
The reference collection is not a finished architectural model or a runtime GLB.
Orthophotos: Lantmateriet, captured 2025-04-24, native pixel spacing 0.16 m.
The broad overview is 0.8 m. Pixel spacing is not positional survey accuracy.
Cyan curves are manually observed image roof edges, not ground-wall surveys.
Green curves identify visible site features; amber inherited app geometry is
hidden by default. Enable that collection to compare the existing approximation.
Use the campus/detail/range/northern cameras and Material Preview or Rendered
shading to see packed reference imagery. Photo/document boards lie east of the
campus. Source links, visible details and evidence gaps are object properties.
The official site diagram is semantic evidence, not a scale map. Generated
illustrations are excluded from architectural evidence. Photo upload dates are
not camera dates. Named facilities follow the club's published information.
Laser returns, when included, retain original coordinates and classification in
separate hidden collections. Class 1 is unclassified, not a building class.
The 2021 laser predates 2025 imagery and subsequent changes. Height statistics
and planar studies are evidence, not certified roof ridges or eaves.
The proposed studio/covered range was announced 2025-12-04 for an autumn 2026
project start. Proposed drawings do not establish a completed building.
Read the packed catalogues and angsobuild/facilities/README.md for reconstruction
priorities, coverage gaps and the full coordinate conversion back to the app.
